sample_unit: survey respondents (102 patients and 13 primary care providers)

links.outcome: Provider and patient acceptance and workflow fit of AI diabetic retinopathy screening during initial implementation
links.effect: All providers agreed the tool would improve access and screening rates; 31% of providers cited initial challenges incorporating it into visits. 75% of patients were open to more regular screening; 81% wanted screening to continue.
links.quote: Some providers also identified initial challenges in incorporating the tool into the primary care visit (31%).

screen.reason: Prospective observational survey evaluating patient and provider experience/perceptions during the real-world deployment of an AI diabetic retinopathy screening system in primary care.
